finalText:
All good — I checked the whole codebase.

`account_id` shows up in 94 files across five services (orders, notify, billing, analytics, accounts), plus old migration files and docs. Most of it is safe to rename, but three spots must stay exactly as they are.

1. `vendor/reporting-sdk/src/client.js` is a vendored, generated file. It says right at the top: don't edit, it gets overwritten by `npm run vendor:refresh`.
2. `lib/serialize.js` turns internal rows into the public API response. Its comment says the field name is frozen by `docs/openapi.yaml`, which every outside client reads by name. That file lists `account_id` as a required field in three places.
3. `lib/audit.js` writes `account_id` into every audit log line. It's used by 25 service files, so renaming it would change the shape of every past and future audit record.

So the honest scope: rename freely through the five services' own code, but leave the vendored SDK, the public API field, and the audit log key alone. That's the one thing I'd push back on if platform team's plan doesn't already call it out.
